## Summary

I've successfully implemented the style card styling fixes on the "What's your style?" onboarding page. Here's what was done:

**Changes Made:**

- **Removed left border styling** - Changed from `border-l-4 border-l-[var(--onboarding-primary)]` to `border-2` with full border around the entire card
- **Fixed selected state border** - Selected cards now show `border-[var(--onboarding-primary)]` (full crimson border) instead of just left border
- **Updated style name text color** - Changed from `text-[var(--onboarding-primary)]` (crimson) to `text-gray-900` (black) to match design
- **Added fixed height to content area** - Added `h-[72px]` fixed height to the card content div for consistent card heights
- **Changed description line-clamp** - Updated from `line-clamp-3` to `line-clamp-2` to prevent height inconsistency
- **Updated CSS class** - Modified `.carousel-card-selected` to use `border-color` instead of `border-left-color`

**Files Changed:**

- `frontend/app/globals.css` - 1 line modified

**Validation:**

  - All cards have consistent heights
